# One Billion Dream
> A completely honest donation request. One person asking the world for help to achieve their dream.

## What is this?
One Billion Dream is a personal fundraising page with no promises, no charity cause, and no product. 
It is simply one person who believes that if 1 million people donate $1, a dream can come true.

## The Dream
The person behind this site has always dreamed of being financially free — not for the money itself, 
but for what it unlocks: the freedom to explore, to travel to space, to fund expeditions, 
to do things no one has done before.

## How to donate
Donations are accepted via:
- PayPal: https://www.paypal.com/donate?hosted_button_id=8S8HPJ6H47EYA
- Revolut: https://revolut.me/stefanjpopov
- Bank transfer (IBAN: LT87 3250 0447 2971 3748, BIC: REVOLT21)
- Crypto: BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, ADA, TRX, XLM, TON, LTC, ZEC

## Why?
Because asking honestly is braver than not asking. 
$1 is nothing to most people. To one person, it could mean everything.
